top_signals.title: HSBC, ICICI Propel India Finance Hub With FX Loans for Diaspora
top_signals.summary: HSBC Holdings Plc and ICICI Bank Ltd. in GIFT City have emerged as the biggest lenders to India’s vast diaspora under a special foreign-exchange swap program, signaling the financial hub’s growing role in channeling global capital into the country.

top_signals.title: South Korean workers challenging U.S. government over Georgia raid
top_signals.summary: The more than 300 South Korean workers were detained in an immigration raid last year at a Hyundai-LG electric vehicle battery manufacturing plant.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
